name: Radiant Capital rUSDCn index-rounding drain
summary: The Aave-v2-derived rUSDCn implementation rounded scaled balances during burns. By repeatedly manipulating the fresh reserve's liquidity index with flash loans, deposits, donations, and withdrawals, the attacker withdrew more USDC than the shares burned and used the inflated position to borrow WETH.
notes: The rUSDCn proxy was created and initialized with the defect-bearing implementation in this transaction. Its implementation slot did not change before the exploit.

Approximately $4.5 million of gross assets was reported lost across three consecutive transactions from the same attacker that invoked the same exploit contract and defect. The individual campaign assets are not repriced here.
The $4.5 million gross loss is a rounded reported total for the three-transaction campaign; individual asset quantities are not structured in this record.
